text_block_list.text: At that moment—a wave of astonishment swept across Tokyo Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ooh... Oooooh, ooh...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Vodka did it! Achieving an unprecedented dream!
With an unexpected route change, she has claimed a crown!
(Ooooooo...?!)

A passionate murmur enveloped the speechless Vodka.
It was a truly bizarre spectacle.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-san...! Vodka did it...
Vodka really pulled it off!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes... You kept chasing after your own sky.
And now, at last...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, she won~!
To think there's someone who could win the Derby on a rotation like that...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Truly—a sky full of stars.
It seems there are as many ideals as there are Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It might look like recklessness... but to those who pull it off,
we should offer our unreserved applause, Teio.
(Ooooooo...?!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Cheers mixed with an uproar...
Is that coming from Tokyo Racecourse...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
“—Indeed, your only path is forward.
Following the fierce passion in your heart—”

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*...
Trainer... Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I did it, I... I finally became myself!
Because you were here with me, right here today!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO!!
HELL YEAAAH!!

Fists clash, and they embrace. It wasn't
a gentle hug, but rather the collision of two beasts.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I was totally amazing, wasn't I?!
choice_data_list: Yeah, you look so incredibly cool!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ain't that right, ain't that right? I just gotta see it through.
If I don't see it through, I won't get my hands on it!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOOOAAAH!
I AM the Derby Umamusume!

"That day, a glory bordering on sheer recklessness
was etched into Umamusume history."
And at the press conference that day—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's awesome! No, it's the absolute best! How do I put it...
I could almost quit being an Umamusume right now!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Not like I could quit, or even want to, though.
Point is, that's just how happy it makes me.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Ahahahaha.
The venue was enveloped in warm laughter.

text_block_list.name: Male Reporter
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Vodka-san. Now that you've won the Derby,
what are your plans for your next race?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my next race?
Well, it's pretty much decided.

I haven't spoken with Vodka yet.
Even so, there probably aren't many other options.

"Return to the Tiara route for the Shuka Sho?
Or perhaps aim for the Kikuka Sho on the Triple Crown route...?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
My next race is obvious! An overseas campaign!
My greatness can't be contained by this country anymore!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna blow away
the world's strongest, just you watch!!

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Eeeeehhhk!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh...?
Does Trainer look surprised too?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Still, going with the flow, this is how it's gotta be!
Common sense doesn't apply to me!
That night—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
My bad! I said I was sorry~!
It's not like I had any ill intentions, it's just, um...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It just slipped out!
I got way ahead of myself.
choice_data_list: Are you seriously aiming for races abroad?
Are you seriously aiming for races abroad?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I already said it, so it's too late to
back out now. Not that I plan to, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "Anyway, I wanna be called cooler! Winning the Derby... man, this has gotta be the only way!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Right? Ple~ase, Trainer?
Is that... a no?
choice_data_list: ...After we get back, the Shuka Sho is next, right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: No! Not the Shuka Sho, but overseas...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hm? What do you mean, "After we get back"...?
choice_data_list: Right, once we get back from the overseas expedition.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Then Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Yeah,
that's the spirit, partner!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You really understand me!
Yeah, by the time we get back, it'll already be autumn!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Let's go overseas! And then make a triumphant return to the Shuka Sho as world-renowned Umamusume!

...And so, we decided to incorporate an overseas
expedition not originally on the rotation.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Thanks once again for helping me
win the Derby, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Still, we're only halfway there.
Let's go even further together, the two of us!
